caption: The drawing depicts an ornate structure resembling a small altar or shrine, situated on a rectangular, layered base colored in shades of light brown and beige with a decorative blue accent near the bottom. The main body of the structure features three large vertical panels framed in green, with the central panels resembling glass or marble in a grayish tone, and geometric patterns in pastel hues at the bottom. The structure's corners and edges are outlined in green, and stylized, leafy green elements are placed at the lower sides. At the top, a decorative pediment is adorned with symbolic objects, including an anchor, a heart, two vases, and a crossed sword and stick, all set against a pink patterned background with diamond motifs. Additional green and yellow ornamental features and garlands are placed above and behind the pediment. A horizontal cornice, decorated with stripes of green, yellow, and blue, separates the base from the upper section. The entire composition is set against a plain, light background, and the drawing is signed "J. Romano" in the bottom right corner.
title: Tabernacle
